answer_1.quote: We propose a task called DimonGen that aims to generate diverse sentences that describe the relationships between a pair of concepts from different perspectives.
answer_1.outputs: diverse relationship sentences describing concept pairs

answer_2.quote: The experimental results in Table show that our proposed MoREE model outperforms all five baseline models in both quality and diversity metrics on the DimonGen task.

answer_4.quote: In order to understand the effectiveness of our proposed MoREE method, we conduct the human evaluation by asking three annotators to assign grades (up to 5) of the generated relationship sentences.
answer_4.guideline: We design three evaluation dimensions: quality, diversity, and grammar & fluency (gra & flu).
